definition: The form of a used before a vowel sound.

spanish.definition: Forma de a que se usa antes de un sonido vocal.

definition: Without much taste.
examples: The soup is a little bland.

spanish.definition: Sin mucho sabor.

definition: Very thin; full of bones.

spanish.definition: Muy delgado; lleno de huesos.

definition: Full of bubbles; happy and full of energy.
examples: He's always bubbly in the morning.

spanish.definition: Lleno de burbujas; feliz y lleno de energía.

definition: Damaged by fire or heat.
examples: He threw away the burnt cookies.

spanish.definition: Dañado por el fuego o el calor.

definition: Not open.
examples: The store is closed on Sundays.
The road is closed because of snow.

spanish.definition: Que no está abierto.

definition: Rough; made of large pieces.
examples: Use coarse salt for this recipe.

spanish.definition: Áspero; hecho de pedazos grandes.

definition: Thick and smooth, like cream.
examples: The sauce is rich and creamy.

spanish.definition: Espeso y suave, como la crema.

definition: Not straight; dishonest.
examples: The picture on the wall is crooked.

spanish.definition: Que no está derecho; deshonesto.

definition: Making a noise when you bite it.

spanish.definition: Que hace ruido cuando lo muerdes.

definition: Soft and nice to hold.
examples: The baby has a cuddly teddy bear.
She bought a cuddly toy for her niece.

spanish.definition: Suave y agradable de abrazar.

definition: Able to be trusted.

spanish.definition: Que se le puede tener confianza.

definition: Wanting what someone else has.
examples: I'm envious of your new car.
She was envious of her sister.

spanish.definition: Que quiere lo que tiene otra persona.

definition: Having a special talent.
examples: The school has a class for gifted children.

spanish.definition: Con un talento especial.

definition: Not easy to see or find.
examples: There's a hidden camera in the room.

spanish.definition: Que no es fácil de ver o encontrar.

definition: Very big.
examples: The house has an immense garden.
The project was an immense success.

spanish.definition: Muy grande.

definition: Famous for something bad.
examples: The prison is infamous for its cruelty.
The infamous storm destroyed the town.

spanish.definition: Famoso por algo malo.

definition: Most important or most successful.
examples: She's a leading doctor in her field.
He played the leading role in the movie.
It's the leading company in the market.

spanish.definition: Más importante o más exitoso.

definition: Soft and wet; too romantic.

spanish.definition: Suave y mojado; demasiado romántico.

definition: Tasting like nuts; a little crazy.
examples: The cheese has a nutty taste.
My aunt is a little nutty.

spanish.definition: Con sabor a nuez; un poco loco.

definition: Covered with oil.
examples: His hands were oily from the engine.

spanish.definition: Cubierto de aceite.

definition: A little fat in a nice way.
examples: These tomatoes are nice and plump.

spanish.definition: Un poco gordo de forma agradable.

definition: Expensive.
examples: That restaurant is a little pricey.

spanish.definition: De precio alto.

definition: Having long, messy hair.
examples: We have a big shaggy dog.
The rug is thick and shaggy.

spanish.definition: Con pelo largo y desordenado.

definition: Soft and smooth like silk.

spanish.definition: Suave y liso como la seda.

definition: Brown skin from the sun; a light brown color.
examples: She came back from Hawaii with a tan.
I got a nice tan at the beach.

spanish.definition: Piel morena por el sol; color marrón claro.

definition: Having a certain age.
examples: She has two kids aged five and seven.
The job is for people aged eighteen and older.

spanish.definition: Que tiene cierta edad.

definition: To talk too proudly about yourself.
examples: He's always boasting about his car.
She boasted that she never studies.

spanish.definition: Hablar con demasiado orgullo de ti mismo.

definition: To move up and down, like wings.
examples: The flag flapped in the wind.

spanish.definition: Moverse arriba y abajo, como las alas.

definition: To sing with your mouth closed; to make a low steady sound.
examples: She hummed a song while she cooked.

spanish.definition: Cantar con la boca cerrada; hacer un sonido bajo y continuo.

definition: To throw and catch several things; to do many things at once.

spanish.definition: Lanzar y atrapar varias cosas; hacer muchas cosas a la vez.

definition: To spill over the top.
examples: The trash can overflowed after the party.

spanish.definition: Salirse por encima.

definition: To look quickly and secretly.

spanish.definition: Mirar rápido y en secreto.

definition: To go bad and fall apart.
examples: The fruit rotted on the ground.

spanish.definition: Dañarse y deshacerse.

definition: To burn the surface of something.
examples: I scorched my shirt with the iron.

spanish.definition: Quemar la superficie de algo.

definition: To write or draw quickly and messily.
examples: The baby scribbled on the wall.

spanish.definition: Escribir o dibujar rápido y desordenado.

definition: To start to grow; a new part of a plant.
examples: The seeds sprouted after a week.
Brussels sprouts are good for you.
New leaves are sprouting on the tree.

spanish.definition: Empezar a crecer; parte nueva de una planta.

definition: To make a short, high sound.
examples: The door squeaks when you open it.
I heard a squeak in the kitchen.

spanish.definition: Hacer un sonido corto y agudo.

definition: To make a long, high cry.
examples: The tires squealed around the corner.

spanish.definition: Hacer un grito largo y agudo.

definition: To take a number away from another.
examples: The kids are learning to add and subtract.
She subtracted the tax from the total.

spanish.definition: Quitar un número de otro.

definition: To pull a car with another vehicle.

spanish.definition: Jalar un carro con otro vehículo.

definition: To run slowly, like a horse.
examples: The horse trotted across the field.

spanish.definition: Correr despacio, como un caballo.

definition: To pull something hard.
examples: The child tugged at my sleeve.
He gave the rope a tug.
The dog is tugging on its leash.

spanish.definition: Halar algo con fuerza.

definition: To fall suddenly and roll.
examples: The kids are tumbling on the grass.

spanish.definition: Caer de repente y rodar.

definition: To open something that is closed.
examples: You can unfasten your seat belt now.

spanish.definition: Abrir algo que está cerrado.

definition: To cry loudly.
examples: She's wailing because she lost her toy.

spanish.definition: Llorar fuerte.

definition: To turn around quickly.
examples: The dancers whirled across the floor.

spanish.definition: Dar vueltas rápido.

definition: To move from side to side in an unsteady way.

spanish.definition: Moverse de lado a lado sin firmeza.

definition: To twist your body from side to side.
examples: The worm wriggled in my hand.
The baby is wriggling in her seat.

spanish.definition: Moverse torciendo el cuerpo de lado a lado.

definition: Something wrong against God's law.
examples: He asked forgiveness for his sins.
It's a sin to waste food.

spanish.definition: Algo malo contra la ley de Dios.

definition: A copy of a document sent by phone line.
examples: We still have a fax machine.
I got your fax this morning.

spanish.definition: Copia de un documento enviada por línea telefónica.

definition: A person who makes sure players follow the rules in baseball or tennis.
examples: The fans yelled at the umpire.

spanish.definition: Persona que hace cumplir las reglas en béisbol o tenis.

definition: The player who protects the goal.
examples: He plays goalie for his team.

spanish.definition: Jugador que protege el arco.

definition: The baseball player who throws the ball; a large jug.
examples: The pitcher threw a fast ball.
He's the best pitcher on the team.

spanish.definition: Jugador de béisbol que lanza la bola; jarra grande.

definition: The baseball player behind the batter who catches the ball.
examples: He's played catcher for ten years.

spanish.definition: Jugador de béisbol que atrapa la bola detrás del bateador.

definition: A place for ice skating.
examples: We went to the ice rink.
The rink is open until ten.

spanish.definition: Lugar para patinar sobre hielo.

definition: The sport of moving through water.
examples: We went swimming in the lake.
She won a gold medal in swimming.

spanish.definition: Deporte de moverse en el agua.

definition: The sport of fighting with your hands.

spanish.definition: Deporte de pelear con los puños.

definition: The sport of moving over snow on skis.

spanish.definition: Deporte de deslizarse sobre la nieve.

definition: The sport of riding waves on a board.

spanish.definition: Deporte de montar olas en una tabla.

definition: The sport of moving on skates.
examples: We went skating on the lake.
She watches figure skating on TV.

spanish.definition: Deporte de moverse sobre patines.

definition: The sport of riding a bike.

spanish.definition: Deporte de montar en bicicleta.

definition: The sport of running.

spanish.definition: Deporte de correr.

definition: The activity of taking long walks in nature.
examples: We went hiking in the mountains.
Hiking is good for your health.

spanish.definition: Actividad de caminar largo en la naturaleza.

definition: The sport of going up rocks or mountains.

spanish.definition: Deporte de subir rocas o montañas.

definition: The activity of chasing and killing animals.
examples: He goes deer hunting every fall.

spanish.definition: Actividad de perseguir y matar animales.

definition: The activity of sleeping in a tent outdoors.
examples: We went camping by the lake.
I love camping in the summer.

spanish.definition: Actividad de dormir en una carpa al aire libre.

definition: The sport of traveling in a boat with sails.
examples: We went sailing on the bay.

spanish.definition: Deporte de navegar en un bote de vela.

definition: The sport of moving a boat with oars.
examples: He's on the college rowing team.
We went rowing on the river.

spanish.definition: Deporte de mover un bote con remos.

definition: The sport of swimming under water or jumping into water.
examples: We went diving in the Caribbean.
She won a medal in diving.

spanish.definition: Deporte de nadar bajo el agua o saltar al agua.

definition: A game where you roll a ball at pins.
examples: There's a bowling alley near my house.

spanish.definition: Juego en el que lanzas una bola contra unos pinos.

definition: A sport with jumps and body movements.
examples: He won a medal in gymnastics.
Gymnastics needs a lot of strength.

spanish.definition: Deporte con saltos y movimientos del cuerpo.

definition: The sport of shooting arrows.

spanish.definition: Deporte de disparar flechas.

definition: The activity of making clothes with wool and needles.
examples: She took her knitting on the train.

spanish.definition: Actividad de hacer ropa con lana y agujas.

definition: The activity of taking care of a garden.
examples: She does a lot of gardening in spring.
Gardening is good for the mind.

spanish.definition: Actividad de cuidar un jardín.

definition: The activity of preparing food.
examples: He does all the cooking at home.
She took a cooking class in Italy.

spanish.definition: Actividad de preparar comida.

definition: The activity of making bread and cakes.
examples: Use baking soda in this recipe.

spanish.definition: Actividad de hacer pan y pasteles.

definition: The activity of making music with your voice.

spanish.definition: Actividad de hacer música con la voz.

definition: The activity of moving to music.
examples: There was music and dancing at the wedding.

spanish.definition: Actividad de moverse con la música.

definition: A game with small black blocks with dots.
examples: The old men played dominoes in the park.

spanish.definition: Juego con fichas negras con puntos.

definition: A board game for two players with round pieces.

spanish.definition: Juego de mesa para dos con fichas redondas.

definition: The feeling of being nervous.
examples: I could hear the nervousness in his voice.
She hid her nervousness with a smile.
Nervousness is normal before a test.

spanish.definition: Sensación de estar nervioso.

definition: The quality of being shy.
examples: His shyness makes it hard to make friends.

spanish.definition: Cualidad de ser tímido.

definition: A photo of the inside of your body.
examples: The X-ray showed a broken bone.
The doctor took an x-ray of my chest.

spanish.definition: Foto del interior del cuerpo.

definition: The act of getting on a plane or a ship.
examples: Show your boarding pass at the gate.

spanish.definition: Acto de subir a un avión o un barco.

definition: The place or the act of registering at an airport or a hotel.
examples: The check-in desk is on the left.

spanish.definition: Lugar o acto de registrarse en un aeropuerto o un hotel.

definition: A melon with orange flesh.
examples: She cut the cantaloupe into slices.

spanish.definition: Melón de pulpa anaranjada.

definition: A tropical fruit with pink flesh.

spanish.definition: Fruta tropical de pulpa rosada.

definition: A fruit like a peach with smooth skin.
examples: I had a nectarine with my lunch.
She bought nectarines at the market.

spanish.definition: Fruta parecida al durazno de piel lisa.

definition: A round red fruit with many seeds inside.
examples: Pomegranate juice is good for you.
She added pomegranate seeds to the salad.
It's hard to open a pomegranate.

spanish.definition: Fruta redonda y roja con muchas semillas adentro.

definition: A dried plum.
examples: My grandmother eats prunes every day.
Prunes are good for your stomach.
She put prunes in the cake.

spanish.definition: Ciruela seca.

definition: A green vegetable with thick leaves.
examples: She cooked the artichokes in water.
I don't know how to eat an artichoke.

spanish.definition: Verdura verde de hojas gruesas.

definition: A long vegetable like an onion.
examples: She made potato and leek soup.

spanish.definition: Verdura larga parecida a la cebolla.

definition: A round white root vegetable.
examples: We grew turnips in the garden.

spanish.definition: Raíz blanca y redonda que se come.

definition: A sweet root vegetable like a potato.
examples: She baked the yams with sugar.

spanish.definition: Raíz dulce parecida a la papa.

definition: Another spelling of doughnut.
examples: I had a donut and coffee.
He brought a box of donuts.

spanish.definition: Otra forma de escribir doughnut.

definition: The quality of being useful.
examples: I doubt the usefulness of this meeting.
The tool has proved its usefulness.
Nobody questions the usefulness of a phone.

spanish.definition: Cualidad de ser útil.

definition: The quality of being rich in taste, color, or variety.
examples: I love the richness of this chocolate.
The richness of the soil helps the crops.
The city has a great richness of cultures.

spanish.definition: Cualidad de ser rico en sabor, color o variedad.

definition: The quality of being hard.
examples: The hardness of the bed hurt my back.
Diamonds are known for their hardness.
Check the hardness of the water.

spanish.definition: Cualidad de ser duro.

definition: The state of being dry.
examples: This cream helps with skin dryness.
The dryness of the air hurts my throat.
Winter causes dryness in my lips.

spanish.definition: Estado de estar seco.
